added: A redesigned interface — calmer surfaces, one type family, and figures that line up down the column
A ranking meter under each post, showing its share of the best one
Smoother motion throughout: rows glide to their new place on a re-sort, meters ease to their new length, dialogs settle in
Thumbnails mark reels and carousels with a small glyph instead of a label
The status line shows when something is running, with progress only while it is
fixed: The update notice vanished when the panel was reopened, until the next check twelve hours later
Escape closed the post behind the chat picker instead of the picker, and arrow keys flipped that post
The list replayed its entrance animation every time anything in it changed
The preview restarted its video and flashed the image when a caption arrived
Closed dialogs could still be reached with the Tab key
Before anything was read, the sort note claimed the posts had no view counts

added: Indigo accent back — clean and neutral against Instagram without going colourless
fixed: Hover controls landed on the avatar and username, or didn't show at all
Position is now measured from the post each time instead of guessed from the markup

added: Neutral monochrome colours, so nothing competes with Instagram's own interface
fixed: Hover controls sat on top of the avatar and username instead of at the right of the header
Controls now shrink to an icon when a header is too narrow for the label
Update check was blocked by CORS — it asked github.com, which the extension has no permission for
Release links now point at raw.githubusercontent.com, the host the extension can actually reach

added: Choose where a post goes: any open Claude or ChatGPT chat, listed by name
Always send to one chat, and clear that from the update window
fixed: Chat picker only appeared with two or more tabs open, so most people never saw it
Update button led to a 404 when the release zip was missing or renamed
New signing key — the previous one was exposed and no longer works

added: Pick which Claude chat a post goes to, by chat name
Remember a chat so it stops asking, and forget it from the update window
Changelog window showing exactly what each release changed
Sound effects for finished jobs, with an off switch
fixed: Update notice repeated the changelog instead of linking to it
Panel hid empty sections behind a stray divider line

added: Send a post straight into a Claude chat — image and caption together
Arrows on the image for stepping through carousel slides
Check for updates, with the changelog for every release
fixed: Carousel posts only ever kept their first slide
Controls sat over the username on the feed instead of in the header
